title: Bar Maryon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was very wealthy and owned property in Rav Yosef’s time, as in Bava Batra 12a. Bava Metzia 24b relates that a bird of prey took meat from the market and dropped it among the date palms of Bar Maryon’s household. The matter came before Abaye.

His sons were also wealthy. Bava Batra 8a relates that Rabbah (Seder HaDorot reads Rava) assessed charity on the orphans of Bar Maryon’s household. Abaye objected; he answered: “I am doing it to give them standing.” Likewise, Ketubot 105a says that Rava borrowed articles from Bar Maryon’s household to honor them.
And we find in Eruvin 19a: Rava bar Maryon.

notes.text: דיו denotes a bird of prey, not a litigant. The orphan assessment and borrowing of objects give the household standing or honor; they do not mean tax registration. Rabbah/Rava is Hyman’s stated Seder HaDorot variant.

Davidson Bava Metzia 24b directly supplies the bird, meat and date palms; Bava Batra 8a reads Rabbah assessing the orphans to give them standing. Hyman’s Seder HaDorot Rava variant and other household/name occurrences remain separate, without adding a genealogy.
